runtime_admission_review: The fixed SPI path now observes actual IDCODE via the existing injected/read MMIO macro and requires the unchanged exact DEV450/REV2003 inline helper. The identity test returns before any HSICFGR evaluation on a non-V cut. This read ordering is established by source control flow; the host model did not record an independent per-address absence trace, and this review does not claim one.

Only after exactV does the path inspect HSITRIM[6:0] and require0x40. Low HSICAL calibration bits are neither compared to64 nor rewritten. Cold admission returns UNSUPPORTED for non-V and STATE for wrong V trim. Existing cold context/invalid and retained/active/foreign-hardware BUSY checks precede readiness. System-not-started remains STATE before electrical admission, as the entry requires a live parent clock.

Transfer/recover/stop use readiness!=SUCCESS as STATE; repeated observations close the original fixed-path gap without tightening generic fixed System or other providers. Rejected fresh cold setup sets no retained/initialized/active state and performs no SPI/pin writes. Transfer rejection occurs before active/CS or a caller-buffer borrow; the existing output count reset and side-effect-free reads remain allowed.

Existing retained owners are not revoked by a readiness failure. A failed stop/recover leaves the owner live until the real external clock fault is repaired and actual public cleanup succeeds. Already-unretained stop stays idempotent. Active-failure nonreturning withdrawal, serial executor and exclusive clock/route ownership are unchanged preconditions, not capabilities granted by matching registers.

The unconditional private clock header provides the existing inline identity fact; no PLL owner calls or state were introduced into fixed code. The observed two fixed Native SPI object files and their matching ELF images contain no pll384 symbols. This bounded observation does not prove all future ARM configurations have identical linking or resource cost.

There are no public API/typed IR/System/state-layout changes. The old full peripheral42 and generated factory11 source bytes remain exact prefixes. Six inherited source files match their original frozen bytes. Stop/drain/quiet/rs-safeCSUSP/EOT/lateRX/CS/SCK/reset and source65/32.5/99.45 divisor regions are byte-identical to batch3; only readiness result propagation and its local identity/trim check changed.
